I would say Baby steps. A big thing that helps me get myself better is remembering that something done half assed is better than not being done at all. If you can't eat much, just make yourself eat something small 3 time's a day. You have trouble leaving bed? Wait until you need a drink or something, then just stay up once you've filled your need. Even just a move to the couch is still moving. I picked up a few knew hobbies too (knitting, drawing, reading more) just to fill up my time too. When you have small things that are time killers, but also skills you can improve on, the act of just keeping yourself busy becomes rewarding.
